findings.detail: From .review-zr804-805-clean (nested INSIDE revenue-forecast), test_case_swapped_project_dir_runs_identical_journey fails because PROJECT_ROOT.parent/'filing-fetch' resolves to revenue-forecast/filing-fetch which does not exist (real sibling is Projects/filing-fetch); the chain returns structured upstream fatal 'filing-fetch script not found'. Per protocol the full file was rerun read-only from the MAIN repo dir: 5 passed in 14.82s. Purely positional.
